verses.gurmukhi: ਚਨਣੁ ਜਿਉ ਵਣ ਖੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ ਓਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chanan jiau van kha(n)dd vich oh aap lukaae|

en.bdb: As the sandal tree tries to conceal itself in the forest (but cannot remain hidden),

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਬਤਾਂ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਪਤ ਵਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: paaras a(n)dhar parabataa(n) hoi gupat valaae|

en.bdb: The philosopher’s stone being identical with ordinary stones in the mountains spends its time in hiding.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦੀ ਮਾਨਸਰੁ ਨਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sat samu(n)dhee maanasar neh alakh lakhaae|

en.bdb: The seven seas are manifest but the Manasarovar remains invisible to common eyes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਰਛਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: jiau parachhi(n)naa paarajaat neh paragaTee aae|

en.bdb: As parijat, wish fulfilling tree, also keeps itself unseen;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਗਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਨਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jiau jag a(n)dhar kaamadhen neh aap janaae|

en.bdb: Kamaddhenu, wish fulfilling cow, also lives in this world but never makes itself noticed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur dhaa upadhes lai kiau aap ganaae||

en.bdb: Likewise why should they who have adopted the teachings of the true Guru, include themselves in any count.
